# Attributes

Part of the **Products** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List attributes

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/products/attributes`

Retrieve a paginated list of attributes with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: options, creator | `options` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by attribute name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[type]` | string | No | Filter by attribute type |  |
| `filter[trashed]` | string | No | Filter by trashed status: "with" (include trashed), "only" (only trashed), or any other value for non-trashed only | `with` |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `sort` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/attributes?include=options&filter%5Btrashed%5D=with&sort=sort&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/attributes?include=options&filter%5Btrashed%5D=with&sort=sort&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/attributes?include=options&filter%5Btrashed%5D=with&sort=sort&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/attributes?include=options&filter%5Btrashed%5D=with&sort=sort&page=1"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

## Create attribute

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/products/attributes`

Create a new product attribute

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Attribute name (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `type` | string | Yes | Attribute type: radio, select, or color. |
| `sort` | integer | No | Sort order (minimum 0). Must be at least 0. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/attributes" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "Size",
  "type": "select",
  "sort": 1
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/attributes", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "name": "Size",
  "type": "select",
  "sort": 1
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/attributes', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'name' => 'Size',
    'type' => 'select',
    'sort' => 1,
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/attributes"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

payload = {
    "name": "Size",
    "type": "select",
    "sort": 1,
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

**Example response** <Badge type="info" text="201" />

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": null,
    "name": "Ms. Audra Crooks II",
    "type": "radio",
    "sort": 73089432,
    "creator_id": 1,
    "created_at": null,
    "updated_at": null,
    "deleted_at": null
  },
  "message": "Attribute created successfully."
}
```

::: details Error response — 401

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated."
}
```

:::
